seatedToss.guidance: Noho ki te tēpu, ka whakahoki tahi kōrua i te peke pūngāwari ki te whāinga nui. Kia tuhia te kaute ki te pepa, tahi.
steps: Tāutuhia te whāinga me te pepa kaute, ka whakatakotoria papatahi ki runga tēpu i waenga i a kōrua.
Noho pai, kotahi ki ia taha. Whakahokia whakarere, kotahi pūngāwari ia tangata, īkā rānei me pass mena kāore koe e pīrangi.
Ina tau te peke ki tētahi mōwhiti, ka tohua e te tangata nāna i whakahoki tētahi pouaka i tana tīwae, i te rārangi mō taua mōwhiti.
Titiro ki ngā tohu tahi, ina pīrangi koe, i te wā ka mutu. Kāore he tangata e herea kia tāpiri i ētahi mea.
Mutu whenever ka rite tētahi tangata.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Whakamahia anake he peke kua rātaihia te uhi, īkā rānei he tōkena kua takaia, noho tonu, kaua e whakahoki ki te kanohi, ā, kia tata mai tētahi pakeke. He raru ngā wāhanga iti ki te kakī.
flags: Ehara mō te iti i raro i te 3: ngā wāhanga iti
safety: Kōwhiria he peke pūngāwari kua rātaihia te uhi, īkā rānei takaia he tōkena ma. Tirohia tuatahi mō ngā rua, mō ngā mahi kāpehu kōhete, kia kore ai e puta mai he whakakī.
Ko ngā pine, ngā raihi me ētahi atu whakakī iti he raru ki te kakī. Kia mawhiti i ngā tamariki iti me te tangata e whakauru ana i ngā mea ki roto i te waha.
Kia tata tonu ki te ringa, ā, kia tirohia tata mēnā ka whakauruhia tētahi mea ki te waha.
Noho tonu. Whakahokia pūmāhana, iho hoki ki te whāinga kei runga tēpu, kaua ki te kanohi.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Te pepa kua tāia: he whāinga e toru ngā mōwhiti, ko Tata, Waenga me Tawhiti te ingoa, mai i waho ki roto, me tētahi kaute he pou mō ia tangata, he rārangi pouaka waahi mō ia mōwhiti.

seatedToss.print: Tāia te whāinga me te pepa kaute

gardenPlanner.notice: He mahere pikitia hei kōrerorero, ehara i te tohutohu tipu.

coloringWall.guidance: Kōwhiria he pikitia me te maha o ngā whārangi. Tāruatia te pakitara, ā, ka tae ia tangata i tētahi, i ētahi atu whārangi rānei. Kāore he wā, he tohu, he penapena rānei.
coloringWall.previewLabel: Kua wāwāhia te {picture|lower} ki ngā whārangi {n}: {across} ki te taha, {down} ki raro. He tapanga kei te kokonga o ia whārangi.
coloringWall.previewCaption: Te pikitia me ngā rārangi whārangi me ngā tapanga kua tuhia ki runga.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Ko ngā reta e heke ana i te pakitara, ā, ko ngā tau e whānui ana, nō reira ko A1 te whārangi i runga i te taha mauī.
coloringWall.wallHeading: Me pēhea te hanga i te pakitara
steps: Tāruatia ngā whārangi katoa. Ko te whārangi tuatahi ko ēnei tikanga me tētahi mahere o te pakitara.
Ka tango ia tangata i tētahi, i ētahi atu whārangi rānei, ka tae i aua whārangi.
Kāore e tika kia rite ngā tae me ngā momo. Ko ia whārangi he wāhanga o taua pikitia anō.
Whakatakotoria ngā whārangi e ai ki ō rātou tapanga, kātahi ka hono ki te teepu ki muri.
Whakaarahia te pakitara ki te wāhi e kitea ai e te katoa.
coloringWall.mapLabel: He mahere o te pakitara: {down} rārangi, ia rārangi he {across} whārangi, kua tapanga mai i A1 ki {last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Ko te rārangi tārua e tohu ana i te tapa o ia whārangi. Whakatakotoria ngā whārangi tapa ki tapa ki taua rārangi, ahakoa ka whakarangirangi iti rānei.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Pikitia: {picture}. Ko tēnei pakitara he {n} whārangi: {across} ki te taha, {down} ki raro.

findTogether.guidance: Whakawhiti wā. I tō wā, huri ai i ngā kāri e rua kia kimihia he takirua. Kimihia ngā takirua ngātahi.
findTogether.viewShowing: Tākaro me ngā pikitia e kitea ana
findTogether.viewHidden: Ngā kāri e takoto huri ana
findTogether.found: {name}: he takirua, kua kitea ngātahi. Nāianei ko te wā o te {next|lower}.
findTogether.allTogether: Kua kitea e koutou ngātahi ngā takirua katoa.
findTogether.different: He rerekē te {a} me te {b}. Kia māhaki, kātahi ka pāwhiri Huri ki muri.
findTogether.waiting: Pāwhiri Huri ki muri i te wā e rite ana koe. Kātahi ka whiti te wā.
findTogether.turnedBack: Kua huri ki muri. Nāianei ko te wā o te {person|lower}.
findTogether.passed: He pai te tuku atu i tō wā. Nāianei ko te wā o te {person|lower}.

drawingDuet.guidance: Whakawhiti wā, tētahi rārangi ia tangata, kātahi ka tuku atu te pene. Ka taea e te tangata katoa te tuku atu. Kāore he mea e tukuna ki tētahi wāhi. Ka wehe atu tētahi pikitia i tēnei whārangi mēnā ka penapenahia e koe anake.
drawingDuet.keys: Ka nekehia e ngā pere te tohu pene i runga i te tuhinga. Ko te pātene wāhi hei whakaheke, hei whakaara rānei i te pene.
drawingDuet.passed: He pai te tuku atu. Nāianei ko tō wā, {person|lower}.
drawingDuet.tookBack: Kua tangohia te rārangi whakamutunga a te {person|lower}.
drawingDuet.noLine: Kāore he rārangi a te {person|lower} hei tango.
drawingDuet.restarted: Kua mā te pepa. Ko te tangata tuatahi te wā. Whakahokia mēnā kāore koe i whakaaro ki tērā.
drawingDuet.restored: Kua hoki ngā rārangi ki pēnei i mua.
drawingDuet.saved: Kua rite tō pikitia. Whakamahia te hononga tango kia penapenahia ki tēnei pūrere.
drawingDuet.paperRules: E rua te tangata, kotahi te pepa, e rua ngā pene. Whakawhitia ngā wā: tētahi rārangi, tētahi hanga ia tangata, kātahi ka tuku atu te pene. Ka taea e te tangata katoa te tuku atu. Kāore he pikitia tika.

colorWash.guidance: Peitahia he tae ngohengohe puta noa i te whārangi, tētahi horoinga i te wā. Hikina te paraihe kia mutu, ā, mutu ai i te wā e pai ai koe. Kāore he mea e penapenahia, e tukuna rānei.
colorWash.keys: Ka nekehia e ngā pere te porowhita o te paraihe i runga i te whārangi. Ko te pātene wāhi hei whakaheke, hei whakaara rānei i te paraihe.
colorWash.canvasLabel: He whārangi o ngā horoinga tae ngohengohe

sortTogether.pickFirst: Matua pāwhiri i tētahi whakaahua, kā tahi ka pāwhiri i tētahi kete.

sortTogether.placed: Kua tau te {name|lower} ki roto i "{basket}".

picturePuzzle.guideText: Koia tēnei te āhua o te whakaahua ina tūhonohono katoa.
picturePuzzle.ownPrivacy: Ka noho tō whakaahua ki tēnei pūrere. Kāore e tukuna ki runga, kāore hoki e penapenahia.
picturePuzzle.ownConsent: Whakamahia ō whakaahua ake. Whakapātai i mua i te whakamahi i te whakaahua o tētahi kāore e taea te whakaae.
picturePuzzle.ownWorking: E whakarite ana i tō whakaahua.
picturePuzzle.ownNotUsable: Kāore i taea te whakamahi i taua kōnae. Kōwhiria he kōnae whakaahua, pēnei i te JPEG, i te PNG rānei.
picturePuzzle.ownWhole: Kua oti anō tō whakaahua. Whakarangirangihia anō ina pai ai koe.
picturePuzzle.ownSheetHow: Tapahia i ngā rārangi. Whakarangirangihia ngā wāhanga, kātahi ka whakawhiti e rua wāhanga i te wā, kia oti ai te pikitia.
picturePuzzle.done: Kua tūhono anō te whakaahua. Tākaro anō, whakatā rānei.

wordSearch.foundAll: Kua kitea a {word}. Kua kitea ngā kupu katoa. Tākaro anō, whakatā rānei.

conversationCards.guidance: Pānuitia ā-waha te kāri. Kāore he whakautu tika, hē rānei.
conversationCards.bigPicture: He pikitia nui, mō te rōpū
conversationCards.passNote: Ka taea e te tangata katoa te tuku atu.
conversationCards.groupTitle: Te tuku i te kāri huri i te rōpū
conversationCards.groupSit: Noho ki te porowhita, kia kitea e te katoa te pikitia. Ko te tangata e pupuri ana i te kāri, ko te pūrere rānei e whakaatu ana i te pikitia nui, ka pānui tuatahi i te tohu ki te reo teitei.
conversationCards.groupPass: Kātahi ka tuku te kāri ki te tangata e whai ake nei. Ka kōrero ia tangata i tētahi kupu, i tētahi rerenga kōrero rānei mō te pikitia, kātahi ka tuku atu.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Ka whakaaetia tonu te tuku atu i te kāri. Ka taea e tētahi tangata te tuku atu me te kore e kōrero i tētahi mea, ā, kāore he tangata e tika kia kī he aha.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Ka mutu te takahanga ina huri katoa te kāri i te porowhita, ina ngata rawa rānei te rōpū. Kāore he toa. Whakamutua i te wā e hiahia ana te rōpū.
